answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 43045 Country: India Title: Tarawih Question: My question is that what is the position of people who offer tarawih 8 rakah only by rejecting the ijma of Sahaba, so what we call them? Are they Muslim/Momin or out of Islam? Answer ID: 43045 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 47/47/M=1434) They are Ghair Muqallidin. They are not out of the fold of Islam; rather they are out of Ahl Sunnah al-Jamah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
